title: Add a release
description: Build a release record from a Spotify link or your files, with the track list and missing details to complete.
outputs: Release details and ordered track list

title: Check my release metadata
description: Compare your release details and track list with your source files to find missing fields and conflicting metadata.

title: Import my catalog
description: Turn a catalog spreadsheet into matched song records, with duplicates and incomplete rows separated for review.

title: Check my song credits
description: Compare songwriter, producer and performer credits across your files and flag missing names, roles and conflicting splits.
outputs: Credits comparison by person and role
inputs: Credit sheets, split sheets or source records

title: Explain this music contract
description: Explain the money, rights, obligations and deadlines in your music contract, with clause references and unanswered questions.
outputs: Questions for your lawyer or counterparty

title: Organize my publishing
description: Build a publishing worksheet from your songs, writers, splits and registrations, showing missing information and conflicting records.
